title: Confirmed historical company shutdowns
scope: AI-related companies with completed whole-company operational cessation. Not a list of companies proven killed by AI, nor a current legal-dissolution census.

methodology.selection: Company or founder statement and/or substantive reporting explicitly confirming completed company-wide closure. Announcements alone require follow-up confirmation.
methodology.dates: Announcement dates are separate from closure dates and confirmed-closed-by dates. Null and unknown are intentional.
methodology.asset_continuation: Subsequent asset sales do not erase a prior closure. Acquisitions without evidence of cessation do not qualify.
methodology.source_access: Read source text via Firecrawl; quotes are short evidence anchors. No claim of manual human review or successful runtime-importer fetch.
methodology.current_status_limit: Historical outcomes were checked. Legal dissolution, continuous operating status through 2026, and every later transaction were not exhaustively audited.
methodology.cost_note: 44 root plus 43 research-agent credits from returned receipts. Monetary charge was not returned; no new paid service was enabled.

companies.name: Nintee
companies.business: AI-driven weight-loss/habit-coaching startup, later consumer learning experiments.

closure_date.basis: April 30 is the dated founder announcement. The year-end founder retrospective proves actual closure during 2024; exact final operating day/month and legal dissolution are unverified.

companies.closure_evidence_summary: Founder farewell concerns Nintee itself and severance for everyone; year-end founder account explicitly confirms the startup was shut down and remaining funding was returned.
companies.ai_relationship: AI-driven weight-loss/habit-coaching startup, later consumer learning experiments.
companies.closure_reason: Not established. Founder cites unvalidated business hypothesis, difficulty changing habits, lack of product-market fit and VC-scale conviction; this is an AI business failure, not demonstrated displacement by AI.

historical_scale.note: Founder retrospectively describes a team of about ten. Do not infer exact layoffs or census at closure.

companies.subsequent_developments: Original farewell offered four months severance and jobs at VWO; retrospective reports six months and offers at Wingify. Preserve the discrepancy; job offers at another company do not mean Nintee kept operating.

followup_check.finding: Founder retrospective confirms actual closure, not merely future intent; live Nintee site still presents farewell. No Nintee restart established in the read sources. This is not an exhaustive current company-register check.

companies.verification_scope: Historical whole-company operational closure; no exhaustive current registry audit.

quotes: We're officially wrapping up Nintee
Earlier in the year, I shut down my startup
I had an amazing team of ~10 people.

companies.name: Olive AI (formerly CrossChx)
companies.business: Healthcare revenue-cycle and prior-authorization automation using AI, machine learning and other automation.

closure_date.basis: October 31 is announcement date. Public company profile explicitly dates cessation to October; exact final operating day is not proven.

companies.closure_evidence_summary: Original announcement described winding down all remainder after selling core units; adviser confirms completed asset transactions, current public company profile explicitly states cessation in October 2023, and subsequent reporting describes the original company as shuttered.
companies.ai_relationship: Healthcare revenue-cycle and prior-authorization automation using AI, machine learning and other automation.
companies.closure_reason: Transaction adviser cites operational/macroeconomic constraints, liquidity problems, debt-service inability and uncertain profitability. No evidence read establishes displacement by competing AI.

historical_scale.note: The read sources report earlier job cuts, not a reliable whole-company workforce census. No total inferred.

companies.subsequent_developments: Waystar acquired Clearinghouse and Patient Access; Humata Health acquired Prior Authorization. Those businesses and technology continued under buyers. Original Olive company cessation must not be presented as every product being discontinued or Humata being the same surviving company.

followup_check.finding: Adviser confirms closed sales; June 2024 reporting discusses Humata as successor asset buyer and original Olive as shuttered. Old Olive announcement URL now redirects to Waystar. Profile metadata can contain stale product listings; only its explicit cessation statement is used.

companies.verification_scope: Historical whole-company operational closure; no exhaustive current registry audit.

quotes: With the sale of our core business units, Olive will wind down the remainder of its business
successfully close two out-of-court transactions before the company’s liquidity ended.
Olive ceased operations in October 2023.
now-shuttered

companies.name: Argo AI
companies.business: Autonomous-driving software company using machine learning and robotics.

closure_date.basis: October 26, 2022 is the announcement/report date only. March 2, 2023 reporting confirms winding-down already occurred; the read sources do not independently establish a final operating day or completion month.

companies.closure_evidence_summary: Initial October report is future-tense; March 2023 retrospective explicitly says operations were wound down, while Ford confirms hiring former Argo workers into a newly established subsidiary.
companies.ai_relationship: Autonomous-driving software company using machine learning and robotics.
companies.closure_reason: Sources establish withdrawal/reallocation of automaker backing and shift toward driver-assist work, not displacement by a competing AI product.

historical_scale.note: Workforce size is not net layoffs: some people transferred to Ford or Volkswagen.

companies.subsequent_developments: Technology, assets and some employees moved to Ford and Volkswagen. Ford Latitude AI is a distinct subsidiary using former Argo talent, not proof original Argo remained operating. No 2,000-person layoff claim is made.

followup_check.finding: March 2023 reporting confirms Argo closure already occurred. Ford official announcement confirms about 550 former Argo hires into Latitude and a strategic change. No original-company restart established in the sources read.

companies.verification_scope: Historical whole-company operational closure; no exhaustive current registry audit.

quotes: It still had over 2,000 employees globally after the job cuts.
months after winding down operations of its former self-driving technology unit Argo AI.
Ford hired about 550 employees formerly of Argo AI

companies.name: Kite (AI coding assistant company)
companies.business: Startup selling AI-assisted programming and code completion.

closure_date.basis: Public farewell was in November 2022; founder describes the venture as operating from 2014 to 2021 and software had been unavailable earlier. Do not manufacture a precise 2022 shutdown day.

companies.closure_evidence_summary: DevClass explicitly reports that the company has officially closed down; Silicon Republic says it will not continue as a business and quotes founder saying development and support have stopped.
companies.ai_relationship: Startup selling AI-assisted programming and code completion.
companies.closure_reason: Founder says model capability was not mature enough and monetization failed; no verified claim that another AI replaced the company. Competition discussion is not proof of causality.

historical_scale.note: Historical size reported by DevClass, not a closure-time payroll count.

companies.subsequent_developments: Much of the code was open sourced. A surviving public repository and installable forks do not show an operating Kite business. Original farewell URL now redirects to a domain-inquiry landing page.

followup_check.finding: Directly read public code repository preserves old code and past-tense project history; it is not a restart notice. Original corporate blog is unavailable at its historical URL. No restart of the original company established in the read sources.

companies.verification_scope: Historical whole-company operational closure; no exhaustive current registry audit.

quotes: has officially closed down
grew to have around 15 employees.
